title: Still Learning
logline: In a mask-carving workshop on the south-west coast, apprentices at every stage work beside a carver who has done it for decades, and who still calls themselves a learner.

object.note: Object 4 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: Different temperaments in one kitchen become different stages in one workshop: apprentices at every level beside a carver who still calls themselves a learner.

thread_out.thread: If even the master is still learning, the way out of the fog is not certainty; in the high hills the fog is literal, and the only way through is to slow down and look.

requirements: A working mask-carving workshop that trains apprentices
A real commission in progress during filming
Consent from the master and each apprentice
